'''The Droid Store''' was a shop located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[R-Duba]] that was run by businessman [[Van P. Quist]]. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were sold by Quist from the store; the former to [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Gavern Starlock]] and the latter to the young [[Kirk Windjammer]].
